source_doc.title: Reuters: Meta internal memo describes multi-year compute supply agreements
source_doc.permission_basis: Copyrighted Reuters reporting; retain only one short, attributed research excerpt and the canonical public URL.

sources.quote: Those include agreements with Samsung Electronics for memory chips, Sandisk for flash storage and Sumitomo Electric for fiber-optic equipment.

claims.statement: Reuters reported that a Meta internal memo described a multi-year supply agreement under which Sumitomo Electric provides fiber-optic equipment to Meta. The underlying memo was not obtained and Sumitomo did not confirm the report, so this is a tier-3 needs-review relationship claim only; it does not establish volume, exclusivity, qualification scope, price, or realized revenue.
claims.disproof_condition: Meta or Sumitomo Electric denies the agreement, or later primary documentation shows that the arrangement does not cover fiber-optic equipment supply to Meta.
